 Ghana 0 - 0 Somalia 2027 Afcon qualifier live updates
 Wia dis foto come from, Issouf SANOGO, David Ramos/Getty Images 
 Published 12 November 2026, 12:18 WAT New Informate one minute wey don pass Read am in 6 mins First Half
 19" CHANCE! Kudus im weak shot no trouble di keeper at all. Ghana dey drive into di Somalia box.
 17" Ghana now dey pile pressure from one side to di oda to pepper di Ocean Stars of Somalia.
 16" CHAAANCE! J ordan Ayew carry di ball enta di box wey im shoot low across di goal, di ball don miss di post by inches.
 15" Somalia don ginger afta dat penalty save from dia keeper.
 Di Black Stars captain be usually solid for di spot but for dat one, na poor kick for di keeper to catch.
 14" MISS! Jordan Ayew don miss di penalty. Di goalkeeper Ibrahim Ahmed bon save di penalty. 
 Alidu Seidu bin win penalty afta Somalia defender pull im short. Ref don give di defender yellow card.
 12" PENALTY TO GHANA. 
 10" Ghana bin dey put pressure for di Somalia box but di final pass no dey go thru.
 9" Combination of number 15 and number 3 for Somalia don stop Afena-Gyan for dat attack.
 8" Afena-Gyan tink say he bin win penalty but referee say play on. 
 6" Jonas Adjetey beat im marker for defence wey im play long ball ova di top - Somalia keeper Ibrahim Ahmed don catch am.
 5" Freekick to Ghana as di Somalia player foul Kudus but di freekick dey wasted.
 4" Ghana dey try create some attack wit Partey and Jordan but anytime dem try, Somalia players dey block all di spaces.
 Benjamin Asare don collect di ball two times already for dis opening three minutes.
 3" Caleb Yirenkyi miss one fine ball ova di top, Somalia don clear dia lines.
 2" OFFSIDE! Ghana player bin dey offside, di game restart fast fast. 
 Somalia no gree for Ghana to carry di ball enta dia yard, di ball continue dey float for di center of di park.
 Thomas Partey, Gideon Mensah and Caleb Yirenkyi bin pass di ball among diaserf 
 1" Somalia get early throw-in but dia ball comot for throw-in to Ghana. 
 Referee don blow whistle for di game to begin for di Essipon stadium for di kontris Western Region
 Di Ocean Stars of Somalia go hope to also out an end to dia losing start for dis qualifiers.
 Di stadium dey packed, di home team dey hope to use di support to turn tins around afta dem lose dia first two qualifiers for Group C.
 Mohammed Kudus, Thomas Partey, Jordan Ayew and Mohammed Salisu all return to di team afta dem miss di last qualifiers wit injury.
 Ghana dey wear dia all-yellow jersey wey Somalia dey wear dia white and blue jersey.
 Officials don lead di players onto di pitch; fans for di stadium dey chant wit di hope to inspire di team.
 Welcome everibody to di Essipon stadium for di Western Region of Ghana under di scorching sun. 
 Mohammed Kudus don return as Black Stars jam dey face Somalia for crucial 2027 Afcon qualifier.
 Di interim manager for di Black Stars Kim Lars Björkegren don name im team for ogbonge Afcon qualifier between Ghana and Somalia.
 Di Black Queens head coach dey lead di Black Stars for dis of games afta dem sack Carlos Queiroz.
 For im team selection, Tottenham Hotspur attacker Mohammed Kudus wey miss di World Cup sake of injury don return
 Somalia head coach Yusuf Ali Nur don also name im starting lineup for dis game.
 Ghana currently dey bottom for Group C wit zero points from two games.
 Somalia also lose dia first two games but dem concede fewer goals.
 Cote D'ivoire bin dey lead di group wit six points followed by Gambia wey also get six points.
 Ghana XI: Benjamin Asare (GK); Alidu Seidu, Jonas Adjetey, Mohammed Salisu, Gideon Mensah, Caleb Yirenkyi, Thomas Partey, Fatawu Issahaku, Mohammed Kudus, Felix Afena Gyan, Jordan Ayew
 Somalia XI: Ibrahim Ahmed (GK); Abel Gigle, Faisal Abubakar, Ali Omar, Mohamed Hassan, Abdisamad Abdullah, Abdi Sharif, Mubashir Nour, Sakarya Hassan, Bilal Njie, Musse Jailani
 Central African Republic referee Andre Onesine Kolissaka-Mbangui dey officiate dis game.
 Im go dey assisted by im countryman Bozoy Oriya Zaoubaye Wilfried De (assist referee I), and Juan Ngua Nguema Eleng from Equatorial Guinea (Assistant II), while Gerson Adolfo Mico Esono Angono from Equatorial Guinea go be Fourth Official.
 Buildup
 Ghana go face Somalia for one important 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying match on Thursday, November 12, wit kick-off set for 3:00pm GMT for Essipong Sports Stadium for Sekondi-Takoradi.
 Di Matchday 3 Group C clash dey come at one crucial time for both teams, wey don lose both of dia opening qualifying matches.
 Ghana never really impress for dia recent international matches. Dem don lose di two games wey dem play so far for di AFCON qualifiers, starting wit 2-0 loss to Ivory Coast, wit goals from Malick Yalcouye and Franck Kessie giving dem di maximum points.

 Dem look like di better side against Gambia for dia second match afta dem take 2-0 lead through goals from Ernest Nuamah and Felix Afena-Gyan, but dem no fit hold am as dem concede four goals in front of dia home fans. Wit dat loss, di Black Stars don now go eight straight AFCON qualifiers witout any win.
 Dem now dey risk missing back-to-back AFCON finals. 
 Dem no qualify for di 2025 edition for Morocco. 
 As tins be now dem sit at di bottom of Group C wit zero points from two games, dem score two goals and conced six.
 For Somalia dem bin dey struggle since di start of di AFCON qualification round. 
 Dem begin wit 2-1 loss to Gambia, wit Bilal Njie wey score dia only goal for 72nd minute.
 Dem suffer dia second defeat, 2-0 loss to Ivory Coast. Dem defend well for most of di game, but unfortunately dem concede both goals for di 80s. Dem sit third for di table wit zero points but wit better goal difference dan Ghana.
 Di Ocean Stars now go look for winning form as dem try to qualify for dia first AFCON in history. Dem neva win in four of dia last five games, including three defeats.
 Ghana team news
 Black Stars head coach Kim Lars Bjorkegren say Ghana must collect six points from di double-header against Somalia, starting with Thursday's 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifier, insisting say di team must respect di opposition but believe in dia own quality to win in front of di Takoradi crowd.
 "E clear well-well. No be secret say we need six points, but we gatz to collect am. We gatz to first win di game . E no go easy."
 For anoda development Ghana don get boost for attack wit di return of Mohammed Kudus to di squad afta e miss recent international games sake of injury.
 In di same way, team captain Jordan Ayew fit start di game afta e recently battle groin injury. 
 However, di Black Stars go miss Antoine Semenyo (knee injury) and Jan Gyamerah (muscle injury).
 Somalia team news
 Somalia no get any major player wey go miss dis window, and you fit expect di same starting eleven wey dem use against Ivory Coast here. 
 During di press conference, di Somalia coach Yusuf Ali Nur say im team ready to play: "We arrive for Ghana, and we ready to play di game against Ghana. We prepare well, Alhamdulillah," e tok.
 Wetin dey at stake?
 Côte d'Ivoire and The Gambia both get six points, meaning say Ghana and Somalia gatz start to collect points immediately if dem still want get any realistic hope of qualifying for di tournament. 
 Di top two teams from each group go qualify for di 2027 AFCON, wey Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda go co-host.
 Dis mean say both Ghana and Somalian teams dey desperate to win.
 Ghana vs Somalia: Head-to-Head
 Ghana and Somalia don meet twice bifor, wit di Black Stars winning both matches. 
 Di first one end 5-0, follow by anoda 2-0 victory, both in 2003. 
 So, di Ocean Stars never score against Ghana.
 Possible line-up
 Ghana : Lawrence Ati-Zigi (GK); Alidu Seidu, Jonas Adjetey, Salisu Mohammed, Gideon Mensah; Thomas Partey, Caleb Yirenkyi; Mohammed Kudus, Abdul Fatawu Issahaku, Jordan Ayew; Brandon Thomas Asante.
 Somalia : Ibrahim Ahmed Hussein (GK); Mohamed Hassan Mohamed, Abel Gigli, Ali Mohammed Omar, Faysal Abubakar Osman; Mohamed Osman, Mohamoud Sharif, Mukhtar Abdi Suleiman; Osman Addo, Bilal Njie Cali, Sakariya Hassan.
